Create and administer user-scoped development connection records.

## `ConnectionsClient`

User-scoped development connections exposed by the executor fixture API.

### `create`

Creates a connected development fixture for one user and toolkit.

Hosted OAuth authorization remains an eyeball Cloud boundary.

```ts no-check
create(options: CreateConnectionOptions): Promise<ConnectedConnection>
```

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `options` | <code>CreateConnectionOptions</code> | Yes | Toolkit slug and optional user override. |

**Returns:** <code>Promise&lt;ConnectedConnection&gt;</code>

**Throws**

- EyeballError with `not_supported` when the executor has no connection route, or another normalized request error.

### `delete`

Revokes a development connection fixture.

```ts no-check
delete(connectionId: `conn_${string}`): Promise<RevokedConnection>
```

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `connectionId` | <code>`conn_$&#123;string&#125;`</code> | Yes | Project-scoped connection identifier. |

**Returns:** <code>Promise&lt;RevokedConnection&gt;</code>

**Throws**

- EyeballError when the connection is unavailable or the request fails.

### `list`

Lists development connections visible to the authenticated project.

```ts no-check
list(): Promise<ConnectionPage>
```

This call has no parameters.

**Returns:** <code>Promise&lt;ConnectionPage&gt;</code>

**Throws**

- EyeballError when the executor request fails.

### `CreateConnectionOptions`

User and toolkit fields for a development connection fixture.

```ts no-check
export interface CreateConnectionOptions {
  /** Uses the client-level userId when omitted. */
  userId?: string;
  toolkit: string;
}
```

| `toolkit` | <code>string</code> | Yes | No | — |
